name: HSUS dogfighting tip line

phones.label: Old line, not on its current materials - email first

notes: animalfighting@humaneworld.org - https://www.humaneworld.org/en/issue/take-action-stop-animal-fighting - suspected organised dogfighting or cockfighting that is not in progress. The HSUS is now called Humane World for Animals, and its 2025 reward poster asks for tips by email; the old phone line, (877) 847-4787 (877-TIP-HSUS), is not on its current materials and may no longer be answered. Reward up to $5,000 for information leading to an arrest and conviction. For fighting in progress call 911. Your identity is protected.
section: Report animal abuse — WHO TO CONTACT

change_log.note: The HSUS is now Humane World for Animals. Its 2025 reward poster: "will pay you up to $5,000 for information leading to the arrest and conviction of a dogfighter or cockfighter. Email tips to animalfighting@humaneworld.org. Your identity will be protected." No phone number on it or on its animal fighting page. The email is added in the abuse workbook; the old 877-TIP-HSUS number is kept but labelled, and a person should ring it to see whether it is still answered.
